title: Editor should finish loading the dependency before resolving dependents.
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in 4.6/4.7
-Non-reproducible in 4.5

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD  Radeon RX 7800 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.31019.2002) - AMD Ryzen 7 8700G w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 61.46 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Upgraded from version 4.5 to 4.7 (and 4.6 when it was released, but couldn't find a solution so reverted to 4.5), a lot of custom resources do not load. The editor tries to load the inherited scenes the custom resources have, without first loading the base scene class, thus throwing a lot of errors and failing to load the resources.

The scenes/scripts that the custom resources are trying to load open properly on the editor after it has finished loading everything. It throws errors on every single custom resource that loads a scene (in my project it is quite a few).

Exporting the project works properly, and running it from command prompt, without any issues.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a project in 4.5
-   Create a custom resource class with an exported PackedScene field
-   Create a custom class and inherit a scene from it.
-   Create a custom resource and add the inherited class in the PackedScene field

2. Upgrade it to 4.6/4.7
- Fails to load
